messages.english: Save a reviewed plan from your own growing estimates.
messages.translation: Vhulungani pulane yo sedzuluswaho i bvaho kha u anganyela haṋu ha u tavha.

messages.english: Check unresolved crop records before using a finance forecast.
messages.translation: Sedzani rekhodo dza zwimela dzi sa athu tandululwa phanḓa ha u shumisa u anganyela ha masheleni.

messages.english: Keep saved growing estimates and nursery settings when signing in.
messages.translation: Farani u anganyela ha u tavha ho vhulungwaho na ndudzanyo dza vhurerelo ha zwimela musi ni tshi dzhena kha akhaunthu.

messages.english: Production plan → Automatic plan from your estimates
messages.translation: Pulane ya mveledziso → Pulane i shumaho nga yoṱhe i bvaho kha u anganyela haṋu

messages.english: Review a complete proposal, save all its planned cycles, then open dated work.
messages.translation: Sedzulusani dzinginyo ḽo fhelelaho, ni vhulunge mitevhe yaḽo yoṱhe yo dzudzanywaho, u bva afho ni vule mushumo u re na maḓuvha.
